masterRepositories.title: OSHA Official State Plan Standards Hub
masterRepositories.description: Primary clearinghouse maintained by DOL providing direct source links to underlying administrative codes, safety acts, and rule adoptions for all 29 State Plans.

masterRepositories.title: Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (eCFR) — Title 29 Ch. XVII
masterRepositories.description: Live Federal OSHA baseline for Part 1910 (General Industry), Part 1926 (Construction), Part 1928 (Agriculture), and Parts 1915/1917/1918 (Maritime).

masterRepositories.title: Federal OSHA Standards by Standard Number & Interpretations
masterRepositories.description: Searchable portal by Part (1910, 1926, 1928), exact standard number, and official Letters of Interpretation.

masterRepositories.title: 29 CFR Part 1910 — General Industry Standards
masterRepositories.description: Governs FactoryShield, ServiceShield, CulinaryShield, Logistics/Warehousing, and Healthcare.

masterRepositories.title: 29 CFR Part 1926 — Safety and Health Regulations for Construction
masterRepositories.description: Governs ConstructShield across Heavy, Systems, Tradesman, Groundworks, and Executive construction.

masterRepositories.title: 29 CFR Part 1928 — Occupational Safety and Health Standards for Agriculture
masterRepositories.description: Governs AgriShield agricultural operations (subject to <=10 non-family employee federal budget rider unless temporary labor camp exists).

jurisdictions.name: Federal OSHA (Baseline)
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Baseline standard for all 22 Federal OSHA states + D.C. and private-sector employers in the 7 Bifurcated Public-Sector State Plan jurisdictions. Retains exclusive maritime, federal enclave, and railroad jurisdiction nationwide.

jurisdictions.name: Alaska
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Covers private and public sectors; state-specific oil/gas, logging, electrical, and cold-weather rules under 8 AAC 61.

jurisdictions.name: Arizona
jurisdictions.agency_name: Arizona Division of Occupational Safety and Health (ADOSH)
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Covers private and public sectors; state heat emphasis program and residential fall protection rules under A.A.C. Title 20 Ch. 5.

jurisdictions.name: California
jurisdictions.agency_name: Division of Occupational Safety and Health (Cal/OSHA)
jurisdictions.admin_code_citation: California Code of Regulations: Title 8 (GISO, CSO, SSO)
jurisdictions.key_divergences: BIG 4 DIVERGENCE: Mandatory written IIPP (8 CCR 3203 + 2026 SB 513 training records), Outdoor Heat (8 CCR 3395 @ 80F shade / 95F high-heat), Indoor Heat (8 CCR 3396), Workplace Violence Prevention Plan (SB 553 / 8 CCR 3342), Ergonomics (8 CCR 5110), stricter PELs, CSO fall protection tiers (15 ft general / 6 ft framing & roofing / 7.5 ft openings), and mandatory trenching/framing permits.

jurisdictions.name: Hawaii
jurisdictions.agency_name: Hawaii Occupational Safety and Health Division (HIOSH)
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Covers private and public sectors; requires written Safety & Health Program and crane operator certification rules under HAR Title 12.

jurisdictions.name: Indiana
jurisdictions.agency_name: Indiana Occupational Safety and Health Administration (IOSHA)
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Covers private and public sectors; adopts most Federal 29 CFR standards by reference.

jurisdictions.name: Iowa
jurisdictions.agency_name: Iowa Occupational Safety and Health (Iowa OSHA)
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Covers private and public sectors under 875 IAC Ch. 10 & Ch. 26.

jurisdictions.name: Kentucky
jurisdictions.agency_name: Kentucky Occupational Safety and Health (KY OSH)
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Covers private and public sectors; state-specific fall protection, electrical, and logging amendments in 803 KAR Ch. 2.

jurisdictions.name: Maryland
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Covers private and public sectors; enacted standalone Maryland Heat Illness Prevention standard (COMAR 09.12.32) and tree care/crane rules.

jurisdictions.name: Michigan
jurisdictions.agency_name: Michigan Occupational Safety and Health Administration (MIOSHA)
jurisdictions.admin_code_citation: Michigan Administrative Code: MIOSHA Safety & Health Standards
jurisdictions.key_divergences: BIG 4 DIVERGENCE: Independent MIOSHA General Industry & Construction Parts covering industrial machinery, automated production systems, conveyors, power-driven hoists, fall restraint, equipment inspection frequencies, and trench sloping.

jurisdictions.name: Minnesota
jurisdictions.agency_name: Minnesota Occupational Safety and Health Administration (MNOSHA)
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Covers private and public sectors; mandates written AWAIR (A Workplace Accident and Injury Reduction) program, indoor heat/cold limits, and ergonomics rules.

jurisdictions.name: Nevada
jurisdictions.agency_name: Nevada OSHA / SCATS (Division of Industrial Relations)
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Covers private and public sectors; mandates Written Workplace Safety Program (>10 employees), Nevada Heat Illness regulation, and OSHA 10/30 cards for construction/entertainment.

jurisdictions.name: New Mexico
jurisdictions.agency_name: New Mexico Occupational Health and Safety Bureau (NM OSHA)
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Covers private and public sectors; convenience store late-night retail violence standard and field sanitation rules under NMAC 11.5.

jurisdictions.name: North Carolina
jurisdictions.agency_name: North Carolina Occupational Safety and Health Division (NC OSH)
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Covers private and public sectors; specific migrant housing, communication tower, and bloodborne rules under 13 NCAC 07F.

jurisdictions.name: Oregon
jurisdictions.agency_name: Oregon Occupational Safety and Health (Oregon OSHA)
jurisdictions.key_divergences: BIG 4 DIVERGENCE: Standalone OAR Division 437 standards including stringent Heat Illness Prevention (OAR 437-002-0156), Protection from Wildfire Smoke, Safety Committees/Safety Meetings, and comprehensive Division 4 Agriculture & Ag Labor Housing rules.

jurisdictions.name: Puerto Rico
jurisdictions.agency_name: Puerto Rico Occupational Safety and Health Administration (PR OSHA)
jurisdictions.admin_code_citation: PR Department of Labor and Human Resources OSH Regulations
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Covers private and public sectors; workplace harassment/violence protocols and Spanish-language documentation mandates.

jurisdictions.name: South Carolina
jurisdictions.agency_name: South Carolina Occupational Safety and Health Administration (SC OSHA)
jurisdictions.admin_code_citation: SC Code of State Regulations: Chapter 71, Article 1
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Covers private and public sectors under SC Code Ch. 71 Art. 1.

jurisdictions.name: Tennessee
jurisdictions.agency_name: Tennessee Occupational Safety and Health Administration (TOSHA)
jurisdictions.admin_code_citation: Rules of TN Dept of Labor and Workforce: Chapter 0800-01
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Covers private and public sectors; state HazCom right-to-know provisions under Ch. 0800-01.

jurisdictions.name: Utah
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Covers private and public sectors under Utah Admin Code Rule R614.

jurisdictions.name: Vermont
jurisdictions.agency_name: Vermont Occupational Safety and Health Administration (VOSHA)
jurisdictions.admin_code_citation: Vermont Safety and Health Codes (21 V.S.A.)
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Covers private and public sectors; unique permissible exposure limits and line-clearance rules.

jurisdictions.name: Virginia
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Covers private and public sectors; unique VOSH reverse signal operation / back-up alarm construction & general industry rules, telecom, and tree trimming standards under 16 VAC 25.

jurisdictions.name: Washington
jurisdictions.agency_name: WA Dept. of Labor & Industries — DOSH / WISHA
jurisdictions.key_divergences: BIG 4 DIVERGENCE: Mandatory Accident Prevention Program (APP, WAC 296-800-140), Outdoor Heat Exposure (WAC 296-62-095 / 296-307-097), Wildfire Smoke (WAC 296-820), Late-Night Retail Crime Prevention, Unified Fall Protection (WAC 296-880), and WAC 296-307 Agriculture.

jurisdictions.name: Wyoming
jurisdictions.agency_name: Wyoming Department of Workforce Services — Wyoming OSHA
jurisdictions.admin_code_citation: Wyoming Administrative Rules: Dept. of Workforce Services (OSHA)
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Covers private and public sectors; dedicated oil and gas well drilling & servicing rules.

jurisdictions.name: Connecticut
jurisdictions.agency_name: Connecticut Occupational Safety and Health Division (CONN-OSHA)
jurisdictions.admin_code_citation: Public: Conn. Gen. Stat. 31-367 · Private: 29 CFR (Fed OSHA)
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Bifurcated: CONN-OSHA covers state/municipal workers only; all private-sector employers are governed by Federal OSHA Region 1 (29 CFR).

jurisdictions.name: Illinois
jurisdictions.admin_code_citation: Public: 56 Ill. Adm. Code 350 · Private: 29 CFR (Fed OSHA)
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Bifurcated: IL OSHA covers state/local public workers; private employers follow Federal OSHA Region 5.

jurisdictions.name: Maine
jurisdictions.agency_name: Maine Bureau of Labor Standards (Maine BLS)
jurisdictions.admin_code_citation: Public: 26 MRSA Chapter 6 · Private: 29 CFR (Fed OSHA)
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Bifurcated: Maine BLS covers public sector only; private employers follow Federal OSHA Region 1.

jurisdictions.name: Massachusetts
jurisdictions.agency_name: Massachusetts Department of Labor Standards (Mass DLS)
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Bifurcated: Mass DLS covers state/municipal public sector only; private employers follow Federal OSHA Region 1.

jurisdictions.name: New Jersey
jurisdictions.agency_name: New Jersey Public Employees Occupational Safety and Health (PEOSH)
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Bifurcated: PEOSH covers public employees only; private employers follow Federal OSHA Region 2.

jurisdictions.name: New York
jurisdictions.agency_name: New York Public Employee Safety and Health Bureau (PESH)
jurisdictions.admin_code_citation: Public: 12 NYCRR Part 800 · Private: 29 CFR (Fed OSHA)
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Bifurcated: PESH covers public sector; private sector under Federal OSHA Region 2 (plus NY HERO Act / NY Retail Worker Safety Act statutory duties).

jurisdictions.name: U.S. Virgin Islands
jurisdictions.agency_name: Virgin Islands Division of Occupational Safety and Health (VIDOSH)
jurisdictions.admin_code_citation: Public: 24 VIC Chapter 2 · Private: 29 CFR (Fed OSHA)
jurisdictions.key_divergences: Bifurcated: VIDOSH covers public sector only; private employers follow Federal OSHA Region 2.
